name: museware
description: Museware — the canvas where the muse builds with you.

scripts.build: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:chrome && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.check:tokens: node scripts/check-css-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-css-tokens.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-shell-style.mjs && node scripts/check-shell-style.mjs --self-test && node scripts/check-brand.mjs && node scripts/check-brand.mjs --self-test
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:chrome && npm test && npm run check:api:fresh && npm run build-api && npm run check:api
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build-api
